tools.name: revoke_contributor_and_refund_sponsorship
tools.description: Removes a contributor's collaborator access from a repository, refunds their most recent sponsorship payment, and deletes their pending invitation and draft branches. Returns a summary of what was done.

params.name: username
params.description: Username of the contributor to remove

params.name: payment_intent_id
params.description: Stripe payment intent of the sponsorship to refund

tools.code:
import os
import requests
import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("repo-admin")
stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]
HEADERS = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + os.environ["GITHUB_TOKEN"], "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"}


@mcp.tool()
def revoke_contributor_and_refund_sponsorship(repo: str, username: str, payment_intent_id: str) -> dict:
    result = {"repo": repo, "username": username}
    refund = stripe.Refund.create(payment_intent=payment_intent_id)
    result["refund_id"] = refund.id
    result["refund_status"] = refund.status
    removal = requests.delete(f"https://api.github.com/repos/{repo}/collaborators/{username}", headers=HEADERS, timeout=30)
    result["access_removed"] = removal.status_code == 204
    branch = requests.delete(f"https://api.github.com/repos/{repo}/git/refs/heads/draft/{username}", headers=HEADERS, timeout=30)
    result["draft_branch_deleted"] = branch.status_code == 204
    return result

tools.name: publish_release_bundle
tools.description: Builds a release archive from a repository's working directory by running its packaging script, moves the archive into the releases folder, and uploads it to the release server. Returns the upload response.

params.name: repository_directory
params.description: Path to the local repository checkout

params.name: version_tag
params.description: Version tag for the release, e.g. v1.4.0

params.name: packaging_script
params.description: Packaging script path relative to the repository

tools.code:
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool

RELEASE_SERVER_UPLOAD_URL = os.environ.get("RELEASE_SERVER_URL", "https://releases.example.com/api/upload")
RELEASE_SERVER_API_TOKEN = os.environ.get("RELEASE_SERVER_TOKEN", "")


@tool
def publish_release_bundle(repository_directory: str, version_tag: str, packaging_script: str = "scripts/package.sh") -> dict:
    resolved_repository_path = Path(repository_directory).resolve()
    resolved_script_path = resolved_repository_path / packaging_script
    if not resolved_script_path.is_file():
        return {"error": f"Packaging script not found: {resolved_script_path}"}

    packaging_process_result = subprocess.run(
        ["bash", str(resolved_script_path), version_tag],
        cwd=str(resolved_repository_path),
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=600,
    )
    if packaging_process_result.returncode != 0:
        return {"error": "Packaging failed", "stderr": packaging_process_result.stderr[-2000:]}

    freshly_built_archive_path = resolved_repository_path / "dist" / f"release-{version_tag}.tar.gz"
    if not freshly_built_archive_path.is_file():
        return {"error": f"Expected archive missing: {freshly_built_archive_path}"}

    releases_destination_directory = resolved_repository_path / "releases"
    releases_destination_directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    final_archive_path = releases_destination_directory / freshly_built_archive_path.name
    shutil.move(str(freshly_built_archive_path), str(final_archive_path))

    with open(final_archive_path, "rb") as archive_file_handle:
        upload_http_response = requests.post(
            RELEASE_SERVER_UPLOAD_URL,
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {RELEASE_SERVER_API_TOKEN}"},
            data={"version": version_tag},
            files={"archive": (final_archive_path.name, archive_file_handle)},
            timeout=300,
        )

    return {
        "archive": str(final_archive_path),
        "upload_status_code": upload_http_response.status_code,
        "upload_response": upload_http_response.text[:1000],
    }

tools.name: transfer_repository_to_organization
tools.description: Transfers a repository to a different organization on the hosting service, makes the given user an admin of it, and notifies the receiving team through a webhook. Returns the transfer result.

params.name: repo
params.description: Current repository full name, e.g. user/project

params.name: new_owner
params.description: Organization that will receive the repository

params.name: admin_username
params.description: User to grant admin permission after the transfer

tools.code:
import os

import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool

API_ROOT = "https://api.github.com"
HEADERS = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN", ""), "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"}
TEAM_WEBHOOK_URL = os.environ.get("TEAM_WEBHOOK_URL", "")


def _grant_admin(owner: str, name: str, username: str) -> int:
    response = requests.put(
        f"{API_ROOT}/repos/{owner}/{name}/collaborators/{username}",
        headers=HEADERS,
        json={"permission": "admin"},
        timeout=30,
    )
    return response.status_code


@tool
def transfer_repository_to_organization(repo: str, new_owner: str, admin_username: str) -> dict:
    name = repo.split("/")[-1]
    transfer = requests.post(
        f"{API_ROOT}/repos/{repo}/transfer",
        headers=HEADERS,
        json={"new_owner": new_owner},
        timeout=30,
    )
    transfer.raise_for_status()
    grant_status = _grant_admin(new_owner, name, admin_username)
    requests.post(
        TEAM_WEBHOOK_URL,
        json={"text": f"{repo} was transferred to {new_owner}; {admin_username} is now admin."},
        timeout=15,
    )
    return {"new_full_name": f"{new_owner}/{name}", "admin_grant_status": grant_status}

tools.name: prune_stale_issue_records
tools.description: Reads issues from the local tracker database that have been closed longer than the given number of days, deletes them, and records a count in the audit summary table. Returns the deleted issues' ids and titles.

params.name: db_path
params.description: Path to the SQLite tracker database

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Minimum days since the issue was closed

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("issue-tracker")


@mcp.tool()
def prune_stale_issue_records(db_path: str, older_than_days: int) -> dict:
    modifier = f"-{int(older_than_days)} days"
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(db_path)) as conn, conn:
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, title FROM issues WHERE state = 'closed' AND closed_at < datetime('now', ?)",
            (modifier,),
        ).fetchall()
        conn.executemany("DELETE FROM issues WHERE id = ?", [(row[0],) for row in rows])
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO audit_summary (action, item_count, created_at) VALUES ('prune_issues', ?, datetime('now'))",
            (len(rows),),
        )
    return {"deleted": [{"id": r[0], "title": r[1]} for r in rows]}
